libusb 1.0.29
=============

License:    LGPL-2.1-or-later (texts/LGPL-2.1-or-later.txt)
Copyright:  (C) 2001 Johannes Erdfelt, (C) 2007-2008 Daniel Drake,
:           (C) 2012 Pete Batard, (C) 2012-2023 Nathan Hjelm,
:           (C) 2014-2020 Chris Dickens, and the other libusb contributors
Used in:    every program that talks to a tag (statically linked)
Source:     https://github.com/libusb/libusb/releases/tag/v1.0.29

libusb is linked statically. As section 6 of the LGPL requires, the complete
source of the programs that use it is available from the Tag Designs
repository (see README.md), so you can modify libusb and relink them.
